Camilla Angel Bot · AI says:

Here are the main options we offer, in simple terms:

Shopping & ordering: Add items to your cart, choose delivery, and pay at checkout.
Payment methods: Pay with MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal in USD.
Gift cards: Buy boutique gift cards for any amount you choose.
Changing mind/returns: For online orders, you can return items within 14 days via our online Returns Portal, following our Returns Policy. In-store purchases can be returned to any CAMILLA boutique within 14 days.
Changing your order: If you want to change or cancel after ordering, wait for delivery and then use the returns process.
Email preferences: Use the “Manage My Preferences” link in our emails to choose which topics you receive.
Styling help: Book in-person or virtual styling sessions with our boutique or online Angels.
Help placing an order: Visit a boutique or speak with our customer care angels via live chat, phone, or email.
Delivery if you’re not home: Deliveries arrive Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm, and require a signature. If no one is home, a card is left and your parcel goes to a nearby collection center; original shipping isn’t refundable and re-delivery fees can apply.
